workload.note: Started all 17 games as a rookie. Franchise record for receiving yards by a rookie TE. Also had 6 carries/8 yards/1 rushing TD (5 total TDs). Played 899 of 1,075 offensive snaps (~84%); lined up at TE for 466 snaps (51.8% of his snaps), plus fullback (64 snaps), wide receiver (384 receiving snaps total), and even 3 wildcat QB snaps.

contract.note: 4-year rookie contract reported in the ~$20.9-21M range (multiple outlets cited slightly different totals: Bleacher Report ~$21M, Sportskeeda ~$20.9M); exact figure not independently reconciled in this pass.

scheme.note: HC Shane Steichen returning for 2026. QB Daniel Jones is the starting QB referenced in camp coverage (Jones quote: 'Certainly expect him to be a big part of the offense again, and he's making a jump on what was a really, really good rookie season.'). Specific offensive coordinator name not confirmed in this research pass.

competition.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
competition.note: Pittman previously drew 111 targets; his departure is cited as freeing up target share for Warren in 2026.

competition.name: Alec Pierce
competition.note: Ankle injury, had offseason surgery; has not practiced in 2026 training camp as of 2026-08-09 with no return timetable.

competition.name: Josh Downs
competition.note: Groin injury; missed practice on 2026-08-09 (Saturday); no recovery timeline given.

competition.name: Ashton Dulin / Nick Westbrook-Ikhine
competition.note: Receiving increased camp opportunities due to Pierce/Downs injuries.

notes: Drafted 14th overall in 2025 by Indianapolis out of Penn State.
Projected to be first or second overall receiving option for the Colts in 2026 if Pierce remains sidelined (Heavy.com, 2026-06-21).

injury.status: No injury reported for Warren himself; entering 2026 healthy per camp coverage.

camp.quote: Tight end Tyler Warren impressed during Colts mandatory minicamp, demonstrating strong performance ahead of formal training camp. Entering his second season healthy and ready for expanded role.
Certainly expect him to be a big part of the offense again, and he's making a jump on what was a really, really good rookie season.
Alec Pierce (ankle, offseason surgery) has not practiced during training camp with no return timetable; Josh Downs (groin) missed Saturday practice.

timeline.injury: No injury reported for Warren himself; entering 2026 healthy per camp coverage.
